topic: Event listener never removed on component unmount firing on stale instance
question: Quick reminder — what was the actual root cause?
butterfly_answer: `handler.bind(this)` creates a new function reference each call, so the reference passed to `.off()` didn't match the one registered with `.on()` — the listener was never removed, causing it to accumulate/go stale.
lastN_answer: The prior context doesn't mention a root cause — the conversation covers refactoring and tooling topics but no specific bug investigation or root cause diagnosis.
needle_fact: In ChartPanel.tsx the useEffect cleanup called priceBus.off('tick', handler.bind(this)); Function.prototype.bind returns a new function reference, so the bus (which matches listeners by identity) never found and removed the original handler, leaving a listener leak on every remount.
